scripts.db:migrate:staging: wrangler d1 migrations apply studyai-news-db-staging --env staging --remote
scripts.db:migrate:production: wrangler d1 migrations apply studyai-news-db --env production --remote
scripts.db:list:staging: wrangler d1 migrations list studyai-news-db-staging --env staging --remote
scripts.db:list:production: wrangler d1 migrations list studyai-news-db --env production --remote
scripts.check: npm run cf-typegen && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run contract:check && npm run deploy:dry-run
scripts.deploy:staging: npm run check && npm run db:migrate:staging && wrangler deploy --env staging
scripts.deploy: npm run check && npm run db:migrate:production && wrangler deploy --env production
